summary: Uniti Group Inc. filed an 8-K regarding its indirect subsidiary Kinetic ABS Issuer LLC completing a private offering of $1,140,710,000 aggregate principal amount of secured fiber network revenue term notes (Series 2026-2). This is a routine debt securitization transaction under the company's fiber-to-the-home program, involving asset-backed notes issued at par with fixed coupons. There is no change of control, merger, or special situation event. The filing is a standard disclosure of a material definitive agreement and a direct financial obligation. No special-situation category applies, as the transaction is an ordinary financing activity rather than an M&A, restructuring, or capital return event.
